chapter: 8.3 Small-Signal Model of the pn Junction

questions.text: A silicon pn junction diode at T = 300 K has the following parameters: N_{a} = 8 \times 10^{6} \, \text{cm}^{-3}, N_{d} = 2 \times 10^{5} \, \text{cm}^{-3}, D_{p} = 25 \, \text{cm}^{2}/\text{s}, \tau_{p} = 10^{-7} \, \text{s}. The cross-sectional area is A = 10^{-3} \, \text{cm}^{2}. Determine the diffusion resistance and diffusion capacitance if the diode is forward biased at (a) V_{a} = 0.550 \, \text{V} and (b) V_{a} = 0.610 \, \text{V}.

answers.text: The minority carrier hole concentration at x = 0 is given by the equation p_h(0) = p_{0} \exp\left(\frac{eV_a}{kT}\right), where V_a is the applied voltage across the junction.
